I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It has the "Audit log" heading, a "Date range" select set to "Last 7 days", and the eight events in a bordered card with Time, Person and Action columns. It follows `DESIGN.md`: the listed colors, type sizes, spacing and radii, 64px page margins, and no JavaScript.

- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so the page falls back to Helvetica Neue or Arial. Install those fonts locally and they will be used.
- **Select options:** The select has only the one option, "Last 7 days". You gave no other ranges, so I didn't invent any.
- **Extra column labels:** I added small "Time", "Person" and "Action" column labels. They weren't in your content, but they help screen readers.
- **Empty `session.json`:** `session.json` was empty, so nothing was missed there.
- **`session.err` warning:** `session.err` holds a one-line warning that the model name `claude-sonnet-5-5` wasn't recognized. It doesn't affect the file.
